requirements_summary: Mid-market product org. Primary goals: predictable latency for in-app chat (p99 < 250ms), embeddings throughput for nightly reindexing (100k embeds/hr), cost control during synchronous user traffic. Prefer private routing for EU customers, need VPC peering. Want model variant strategy: high-quality fp16 for premium customers, quantized 4-bit variant for standard tier. Canary plan required before any traffic shift. Must have SSO (SAML), KMS integration, audit logs, 90-day retention policy for request logs.
poc_scope: 4-week Dedicated POC on 2x A100 equivalent nodes reserved: week 1 baseline migration of small chat traffic, week 2 canary (10% live traffic) + monitoring, week 3 scale to 50% and run throughput tests (embeddings batch jobs), week 4 rollback drills and SLA verification. Provide canary routing config, fallback to hosted API and to smaller quantized model, and region failover from eu-west to us-west in case of regional outage.
canary_and_fallback_plan: Canary: start at 10% of user sessions for 72h, observe latency/error/quality metrics. Fallback routing: primary -> Dedicated fp16 variant; fallback1 -> Dedicated quantized variant; fallback2 -> Hosted API standard model in same region; region failover: eu-west -> us-west-hosted variant. Rollback triggers: p99 latency > 250ms for 30min, error rate increase > 1.5x baseline, automated quality regression on eval set (>3% delta). Rollback procedure documented and SE-runbook to be delivered pre-POC.
pricing_concerns: Wants clear delta between hosted unit costs and committed Dedicated price. Interested in burst capacity pricing, canary discount, and an option to convert POC commit into annual reserved with credit for POC usage. Finance requires topline ARR impact and an example bill for 3 typical months.
legal_and_compliance: Requires DPA/Controller-Processor language updated for EU residency, wants KMS/HSM key control, SOC2 attestation copy. Data retention policy: request logs retained 90 days, embeddings stored encrypted and rotatable keys. Air-gap not required; on-prem not needed at this stage.
